alternatives.migrationNotes: Captures screen, camera and audio locally with scenes; upload/export files into another service for Loom-style link sharing and team feedback. No Loom library importer established.

Browser extension handles unlimited capture, annotations and MP4/GIF/WebM exports. Self-host is local-only; sharing via external storage or paid Pro. No migration preserving Loom comments/analytics established.

Closer capture-and-sharing workflow with own-server deployment. Loom importer supports URLs/CSV but is Pro-gated, requires download access and maps space labels rather than nested folder hierarchy. Build desktop from source for commercial-license exemption.

uncertainties: Cap OSS source is AGPL with MIT capture crates; official desktop binaries require paid commercial rights, while self-built versions are exempt. Full self-host subscription-feature parity remains unverified.
Screenity Pro is a separate hosted platform; do not imply its web editor/sharing/caption features are in the GPL extension.
Loom displayed price billing-toggle state requires verification before numeric pricing publication.
